[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (xs: List Int) (result: List Int) : List Int :=
  match xs with
  | [] => result
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_result := (head :: result)
    loop tail new_result
loop xs []
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation xs
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_length := List.length_loop result xs
  simp [h_length]
  have h_result := List.loop_invariant result xs
  simp [h_result]
  have h_result_reverse := List.reverse_loop result xs
  simp [h_result_reverse]
  simp [check_derivative]
  simp [reverse]
  simp [reverse]
  simp [reverse]
  exact h_result_reverse
[END]
